answer: Each identity files a copper thread on the referral graph, locking 75 credits in escrow; a referrer vouches for three per epoch. Peers may dispute a thread: the auditor replays the public log; a copper thread that may wander off its route burns the newcomer bond, slashes the referrer. Filing is 40; 1,000 fakes pay 40,000, lock 75,000, rent 334 slots at 300 from the rented-referrer ring. Honest weavers pay 40 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
